Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the THSTI Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post is scheduled for 30 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they are present at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: The essential educational qualification for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) position is a Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Knowledge of government rules and regulations is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 35,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the THSTI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this THSTI job?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Faridabad, Haryana, 121001.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. How many vacancies are available for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Highly Skilled (Executive Assistant) post at the Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI).
